message: The other day, while rummaging through our emergency go-bags, I found the old family documents I had tucked away. I felt a smidge of that smug 'I told you so' feeling when I remembered all those times I insisted on having them ready 'just in case.' It's funny how those little moments of preparedness make me feel like I've got my life together, even when the laundry's piled high. Do you have any go-to tips for staying organized in a busy household?
